text: Acceptance amendment: on a material failure transition, collection records scheduler/accounting reason and an optionally bounded marker/log attachment, then triggers a bounded pinned-revision workspace projection. It keeps execution, artifacts, validation, dependency, and freshness separate. If projection conflicts or is deferred, local monitor health exposes `campaign_commit_pending`; unchanged failure polls do not rewrite a remote view. Tests prove a failed allocation with partial or missing output does not invent an artifact or validation result.
